subject: POC kickoff — finalize hands-on session time and preflight items
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session planning & proposed times

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the good conversation yesterday. We'd like to lock in the POC kickoff + hands-on working session where we'll walk through prompts, routing, and run a short load test. Proposed windows (Pacific time):

- Tue Oct 20 — 10:00–12:00 PT (deep-dive + 30m load test)
- Wed Oct 21 — 13:00–15:00 PT (shorter agenda, focused on prompt review)
- Thu Oct 22 — 09:00–11:00 PT (recommended for US east teams)

Please let me know which slot works best, and whether you need a different timezone. We're planning to share:
- A 30-minute demo + 30-minute hands-on prompt review
- A 30-minute load test window (non-prod keys)
- Pre-reads (agenda, sample prompts, network checklist)

I've attached a draft agenda and a preflight checklist for your team to review (poc-agenda-v1.pdf, preflight-checklist.md). Marissa will own the prompt set; Dev will coordinate the load test config.

If any legal/security folks want to join the pre-call to review network requirements, please let us know and we'll loop them in.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Sergio
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF), preflight-checklist.md (text)

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novusai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovusAI POC Team <poc-team@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session planning & proposed times

Hi Sergio,

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and checklist. Quick note from our side:
- Our engineering manager and a security lead want to attend; they are only available after 11:30 PT.
- Can we shift the load test to the end of the session and limit it to 20 minutes? We need to schedule an internal window for test infra.

Available for the follow-up windows (we're PST as well):
- Tue Oct 20 — 11:30–13:30 PT (works if you can shift start)
- Thu Oct 22 — 12:00–14:00 PT

Also, can you share sample prompts you're planning to use? Our team will sanitize PII but we'd like to review in advance.

Elena Martinez
CTO, NovusAI
poc-team@novusai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novusai.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session planning & proposed times

Elena — great, thanks for the constraints. A few operational notes and attachments I'm adding:

- I've attached the sample prompts CSV and a brief 'how we evaluate' checklist (sample-prompts.csv).
- Agenda suggestion (90 minutes):
  1) 15m — Introductions & goals
  2) 25m — Demo: routing + model variants
  3) 20m — Hands-on prompt tuning (Marissa leads)
  4) 20m — Load test (Dev leads, final 20m)
  5) 10m — Next steps & success metrics

Action items for NovusAI before the call:
- Confirm test keys and IP allowlist (per preflight-checklist.md)
- Provide 2–3 example prompts you'll want to tune (we'll use sanitized versions)

Security note: Hannah from our security team will join for the network portion. If you prefer, we can set a 15-minute security-only pre-call the day before.

Attachments: sample-prompts.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovusAI POC Team <poc-team@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session planning & proposed times

Thanks Marissa — that agenda looks good. Small update: can we do Thursday Oct 22 at 12:00–13:30 PT (90m) and run a 20-minute load test at 13:10–13:30? That gives our infra a buffer.

We'll prepare sanitized prompts and confirm the IPs by Wednesday EOD. Security prefers the short pre-call; please schedule if Hannah is available.

Elena

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novusai.com>

Perfect — Thursday Oct 22, 12:00–13:30 PT is confirmed on our side. I've attached the updated agenda (poc-agenda-final.pdf) and a short preflight checklist (preflight-checklist.md). Calendar invite/ICS will follow; please accept when you see it.

Quick checklist reminders:
- Novus to share sanitized prompts by Wed 18:00 PT
- Confirm test API keys and IP allowlist
- If you want the security pre-call, suggest Wed Oct 21 at 11:30 PT (15m)

I've added a shared Drive folder for pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_poc-prereads

Thanks everyone — excited to run this with you.

Sergio
